text:
maria: Heads-up — scheduling maintenance in apac-west1 tonight 00:30-02:30 UTC. We'll be applying NIC microcode + GPU driver updates. Expect brief enqueueing + higher p95 for short windows. Will need cross-region hedging for best-effort pools.

raj: +1. Proposal: net-queue-swap to us-east1 for non-dedicated pools, do 10% cohort canaries, then ramp every 15m. Avoid moving dedicated/reserved tenants.

chen: Important: reserved customers are pinned to pool-apw1A and apw1B. We must not evict those. If we do any backfill, respect label `reserved:true`.

eden: Ops note — we should reseed KV cache after each cohort handoff (5m settle) or we see token-latency spikes. I can own the reseed hooks.

maria: SRE: please run preflight and confirm egress capacity + routing changes. I'll set autoscale min to 0.2x for best-effort pools during the window.

sre-bot: INC-2026-1045 created: "apac-west1 NIC+GPU driver maintenance". Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/apac-west1-maint. Ops channel reserved: #eng-infra-maint.

raj: Quick cost math: cross-region egress for sustained backfill could be ~$400-800/hr depending on concurrency (est. 100-250Gbps). Stagger to reduce peak egress.

chen: Preflight checklist (will run now): `/scripts/preflight-check --region=apac-west1 --checks=egress,kvcache,pools` — will post results in 15m.

eden: Playbook snippet for cohort rebalance (dry-run first):
```
# cohort rebalance dry-run
rebalance --source apac-west1 --target us-east1 --pool best-effort --cohort-size 10% --dry-run
sleep 60
rebalance --commit --cohort 10%
```

raj: Also: update smart-routing to prefer local replicas when latency <120ms; fallback to us-east1 if >120ms or packet-loss observed. Adds resilience during partial roll.

maria: Can we avoid cross-region for any pools currently under reserved contracts? Chen?

chen: Confirmed — I'll create a tmp exclusion rule `no-cross-region=true` for reserved pools and validate in the preflight.

eden: Timeline I'm proposing: canary cohort @00:30, second cohort @00:45, ramp cohorts @01:00 and @01:15, final cleanup @02:15. Each cohort includes KV reseed and 5m watch.

raj: Throttle plan: if p95 CPU or model lat >2x baseline, pause ramp and fall back. We'll track cost delta and file if >$1k deviation.

maria: I'll publish customer-comm at 21:00 UTC (notice + opt-out for reserved customers). Also enabling increased logs/trace retention for the window.

sre-bot: Deploybot: rolling driver rollout queued (12 nodes). Status: 0/12 complete.

eden: I'll be on #eng-infra-maint for the window, will signal all-green after each cohort.

maria: Thanks — please flag any blockers here. If no objections by 23:30 UTC I'll proceed with the plan. :thumbsup:
